title: Telemetry stack hygiene: OTEL upgrade, span enrichment, and metric cardinality cleanup
creator: Ava Martinez
description: We have accumulated telemetry tech debt across services: old OpenTelemetry SDKs, duplicated span-enrichment logic, and high-cardinality metric tags that are driving costs and slow queries. This ticket coordinates an organization-wide effort to (1) upgrade OTEL SDKs and exporters in Go/Python/Node, (2) centralize span enrichment into a small, reviewed middleware layer to avoid hot CPU paths, (3) apply a metric tag whitelist + derived low-cardinality metrics, and (4) tune exporter batching, retry and sampling defaults to improve tail latency and reduce egress costs.
acceptance_criteria: All backend services using OTEL SDKs upgraded to supported LTS versions (Go: go.opentelemetry.io v1.11+, Python: opentelemetry 1.20+, Node: @opentelemetry/sdk 1.x)
Span enrichment logic removed from hot request paths and provided via standard middleware with <2% CPU overhead in p99 measurements
Metric cardinality reduced by at least 60% for identified high-cardinality families (verify with analysis dashboard)
Exporter batch sizes and retry strategy deployed with reduced export latency variance (p99 export latency down by >=30%)
Automated CI checks added: OTEL version linting, tag-whitelist conformance, and telemetry unit tests
Canary rollout completed for key services (auth-proxy, api-gateway, inference-runtime) with rollback plan validated
notes: Background: Over the last 18 months we've seen rising Prometheus/Grafana query costs and slower trace ingestion. A quick audit (Confluence doc) identified 14 services with out-of-date OTEL libs and four services with manual span mutation in hot loops.
Primary goal is stability and measurability; feature parity for existing traces/metrics must be maintained during rollout
activities: 2025-01-15 - Kickoff meeting with Infra, Runtime, and Platform teams. Agreed scope and danger signals (trace loss, metric gaps, CPU regressions). Action items assigned.
2025-01-20 - Audit complete: list of affected services added to Confluence. Identified top 6 metric families by cardinality and 4 span enrichment hotspots.
2025-01-22 - PoC: go-service OTEL upgrade and middleware implemented. Preliminary bench: 12% CPU reduction on p95 for endpoint X. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4187
2025-01-28 - Review feedback from Security & Observability: add deterministic tag-whitelist for user-facing metrics, avoid PII in spans. Action: add unit tests and sanitizer utils.
2025-01-30 - Python services: vendor patch created to fix exporter batching bug in opentelemetry-exporter-otlp. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/py-lib/pull/232
2025-02-02 - Canary plan drafted: 10% traffic for api-gateway, 5% for inference-runtime. Canary will include detailed dashboards and an automatic rollback window of 30 minutes.
2025-02-03 - Integration test added to CI: telemetry smoke asserting that spans and key metrics are emitted for synthetic request flows. Jenkins job: telemetry-smoke-suite

2025-02-04 - Started canary on staging cluster (api-gateway). Early observations: exporter batch size 50 -> reduces export count by ~28%, small bump in request p99 (+1.8%); monitoring team flagged one missing derived metric which will be added before prod canary.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Trace or metric gaps during rollout. Mitigation: start with staging, enable span/metric validation checks, maintain feature flag to revert instrumentation changes.
Risk: Increased p99 latency due to instrumentation changes. Mitigation: measure end-to-end p99 per-service and have fallback to previous exporter config and sampling rules.
Risk: Developer friction from new middleware API. Mitigation: provide a small compatibility shim and migration guide (Confluence + example PRs).
Risk: CI flakiness from new telemetry tests. Mitigation: make telemetry smoke tests idempotent and timeout-tolerant; run them in a separate pipeline.
Operational note: Coordinate with SRE for on-call during prod canaries; add escalation path in runbook.
next_steps: Complete canary on staging and address missing derived metric (due 2025-02-06)
Merge OTEL upgrades across top 10 services with small-batched rollouts (target merge window 2025-02-10 -> 2025-02-14)
Add automated telemetry linting to pre-commit and CI (deadline 2025-02-12)
Post-mortem template prepared for any regressions during rollout
